ledgerline: a small ledger for the terminal
ledger line reads plain text journals and prints the balance of every account. It needs no database and no account on a server.
Install the latest release with Homebrew and check the version.
Run it with --month 2026-09 to see one month only. Settings live in ~/. ledgerrc .
Bug reports are welcome. Please run make test before you open a pull request.

How do I flatten a nested array in JavaScript?
Since ES2019 you can call Array. prototype. flat () . Pass a depth when the nesting is deeper than one level.
const nested = |1, 12, 13, [4]]]]; // flatten every level at once const flat = nested. flat(Infinity); console. log(flat); // 11, 2, 3, 4]
const nested = |1, 12, 13, [4]]]]; // flatten every level at once const flat = nested. flat(Infinity); console. log(flat); // 11, 2, 3, 4]
On an older runtime, install a polyfill first.
Avoid _ concat here, because it only removes one level.
